title: Institutions are Piling Into Bitcoin ETFs, Pushing Holdings to a Record
summary:
Bitcoin Magazine

Institutions are Piling Into Bitcoin ETFs, Pushing Holdings to a Record

Galaxy Research says 13F filers added 49,229 BTC through U.S. spot bitcoin ETPs in Q3, lifting institutional holdings to a record 356,491 BTC as Wells Fargo became the largest holder.

This post Institutions are Piling Into Bitcoin ETFs, Pushing Holdings to a Record first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: Swiss Bank Sygnum Says Bitcoin Could Reach New High Near $128,000
summary:

Swiss Bank Sygnum Says Bitcoin Could Reach New High Near $128,000

The Swiss bank estimates bitcoin could hit a new all-time high near $128,000 and calls the current downturn the shallowest bear market to date, as bitcoin moves into reserve portfolios.

This post Swiss Bank Sygnum Says Bitcoin Could Reach New High Near $128,000 first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.

title: CLARITY Act Likely Dead Until 2027, Top Crypto Lawmakers Warn
summary:

CLARITY Act Likely Dead Until 2027, Top Crypto Lawmakers Warn

House Financial Services Chairman French Hill said the CLARITY Act's chances in the lame-duck session are "not high," pushing the crypto market structure bill toward a Democratic-led Congress.

This post CLARITY Act Likely Dead Until 2027, Top Crypto Lawmakers Warn first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman.
